description: RbCa₂NaNb₄O₁₃ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mmm space group. Rb is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent O atoms. All Rb-O bond lengths are 3.20 Å. Na is bonded to twelve O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with eight equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (2.81 Å) and eight longer (2.84 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ca is bonded to twelve O atoms to form distorted CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with four equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra,  a faceface with one NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.55-3.01 Å. There are two inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-2.32 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with five equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.02 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Ca and two equivalent Nb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OCa₂Nb₂ trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ca, and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Ca and two Nb atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to four equivalent Rb and one Nb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Nb₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
